prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1016; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described in your file, which involved a low-speed head-on impact. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person. Any request for a statement, recorded or otherwise, must be routed through us.

We ask that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including the liability limits applicable to the insured driver and any other coverage that may apply to this loss, within fourteen days of receiving this letter. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage has been issued.

Your insured and your company are hereby placed on notice to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle inspection reports, telematics or event data recorder downloads, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster diary entries, and all communications with the insured or third parties. Routine destruction or alteration of any such material must be suspended immediately.
